Native speech components linked into the BoBe daemon

ptts 0.4.0-rc.2 (Gradium / Laurent Mazare), https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts
  MIT, selected from MIT / Apache-2.0: ptts-MIT.txt

xn 0.2.11 (Laurent Mazare), commit 878928e6bc9e10686b3bcd5dd422ae81f54c24cb,
https://github.com/LaurentMazare/xn
  MIT, selected from MIT / Apache-2.0: xn-MIT.txt

xn-gemm family 0.20.2 (Gradium), commit f74bc3c2b5c668d9de964b8f4f6151bff97d0f21,
https://github.com/gradium-ai/gemm
  MIT: gemm-MIT.txt

signalsmith-stretch 0.1.3 (Colin Marc) with the bundled Signalsmith Stretch and
Signalsmith Linear C++ libraries (Signalsmith Audio)
  MIT: signalsmith-rust-MIT.txt, signalsmith-stretch-MIT.txt,
  signalsmith-linear-MIT.txt

sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 recognition-only static libraries, https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
  Apache-2.0: sherpa-onnx-APACHE.txt. The same archive links these components:
  - kaldi-decoder, kaldifst, kaldi-native-fbank (k2-fsa): Apache-2.0
  - OpenFst (Google): Apache-2.0
  - simple-sentencepiece: Apache-2.0
  - KISS FFT (Mark Borgerding): BSD-3-Clause, kissfft-BSD-3-Clause.txt
  - utf8proc 2.12.0 (Julia developers, Public Software Group): MIT, with its
    Unicode data license, utf8proc-MIT.txt
  - ONNX Runtime 1.28.2 (Microsoft): MIT, onnxruntime-MIT.txt, with the notices of
    the libraries it contains in onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt

The text of the Apache License 2.0 is in sherpa-onnx-APACHE.txt. Model weights are
not covered here; see docs/speech.md in the source and the NOTICE.txt installed
with each speech pack.
